entries.title: About CynExtra-AI
entries.content: CynExtra-AI is an intelligent AI workspace for chat, projects, tools, and creative work. It supports multiple models (Nova, Swift, Core, Think, Code, Vision, Max), conversation memory, and optional website search.

entries.title: CynExtra Model Family
entries.content: CynExtra Swift is the free fast model. CynExtra Nova is available on Pro. CynExtra Core, Think, Code and Max are Ultimate-plan model profiles. Each profile must map to a real configured provider model; this development build may map multiple profiles to the same provider model. Vision is unavailable until a real vision-capable provider is configured.

entries.title: Safety principles
entries.content: CynExtra-AI should be used responsibly. Do not request illegal or harmful activities. Verify important AI-generated information before relying on it.
